_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic, local-only). The AUTHORITY is the official v3 columns dictionary (guides/reporting/v3/columns -- 740 columns: name, Type, report-type availability), transcribed verbatim into Annex B of _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/research/amazon-ads-catalog-research.md (fetched 2026-07-21 via a JS renderer). There is NO machine-readable enum: Reporting_prod_3p.json on CloudFront is an empty stub and the docs site is client-side rendered. The per-report-type pages (section 3 of the dossier) are used ONLY to detect page-vs-dictionary divergences: a dictionary column absent from EVERY page list is cataloged exposure=excluded with a probe-to-confirm reason (settled by the 25.6 live probe).

alias_table._note: dictionary-side reportTypeId spellings normalized to the report-type pages' ids; type typos Deciimal/Deciaml/decimal normalized to Decimal. The generator FAILS LOUDLY on any unknown token (never a silent drop).

_derivation.field_identity: Unlike Meta/Google there is no metric-vs-dimension split in the request: everything is a 'column' in configuration.columns and the report grain comes from groupBy + timeUnit. kind=dimension for String/date columns and *Id columns; kind=metric for the numeric rest. Ratio/derived columns (clickThroughRate, costPerClick, acosClicks*, roasClicks*, *Rate, *Percentage, *Share, eCP*) are cataloged with a NON-ADDITIVE note (AD-4, semantic-layer computed). Landing numeric coercion is driven by the catalog physical_type, never by an id suffix.
_derivation.count_divergence: Official 740 vs Supermetrics 166: Supermetrics still exposes v2-era field names (attributedConversions14d families) plus derived ACOS/ROAS ratios per attribution window and account/query metadata -- only 45/166 ids match official v3 names (case-insensitive). Tier weighting / labels / DEPRECATED negative signal only, never identity. Airbyte requests 16-67-column subsets per report type (~50-70% of requestable) and carries two v2 leftovers (leads, leadFormOpens) ABSENT from the official dictionary -- deliberately NOT cataloged (cross-reference only).

probe.structural_note: Amazon probe style for the 25.6 ratify harness: a probe = POST /reporting/reports with a 1-day window, timeUnit DAILY, the report type's minimal groupBy, and configuration.columns = the batch; then poll to COMPLETED/FAILED and download. A 400 on creation is bisected to the exact rejected column (invalid_request); FAILED maps via failureReason; 425 means an identical probe is already in flight (reuse the reportId, never re-POST); 429 pauses and resumes the SAME batch (Retry-After honored). Batches are per reportTypeId. probe-to-confirm columns (excluded_fields with the probe reason) and the two membership divergences (sdTargeting video family page omission; spPurchasedProduct 'targeting') are the tie-break targets. Budget: 1 probe report per reportTypeId per batch, spread through the day (regional report-queue quota).

report_type_compatibility._note: Request-build map consumed by connector.py: every selection is validated against ONE reportTypeId's column set (field_compatibility rules / report_type_columns.json) + its legal groupBy and filters BEFORE the API call. timeUnit rule: DAILY requires column 'date'; SUMMARY uses startDate/endDate. Filters must be supported by ALL groupBy values in the configuration. Review 26.5 F-4: BOTH the max window (max_range_days) AND the retention floor (retention_days) are PER REPORT TYPE (dossier section 2), refused pre-call by the type's own value -- NOT a uniform 31/95. Most sponsored types are 31/product-floor; the exceptions are spGrossAndInvalids 365/365, sbPurchasedProduct 731/731, sp/sbPromptAdExtension max-range 90. sb/sdGrossAndInvalids are ABSENT from the section-2 table -> conservative (31 + product floor) + probe-to-confirm.

spGrossAndInvalids._range_note: Dossier section 2: spGrossAndInvalids is the one sponsored report type with a 365-day max range AND 365-day retention (audit shape).

spPromptAdExtension._range_note: Dossier section 2: prompt-ad-extension max range 90 days (retention 95).

sbPurchasedProduct._range_note: Dossier section 2: sbPurchasedProduct max range AND retention are both 731 days.

sbGrossAndInvalids._range_note: ABSENT from the dossier section-2 configuration table. Conservative default = the SB retention floor (60) + the v3 31-day max range; probe-to-confirm in ROLLOUT_NOTES (spGrossAndInvalids is 365/365, so the SB/SD gross shapes MAY be wider).

sbPromptAdExtension._range_note: Dossier section 2: prompt-ad-extension max range 90 days (retention 95).

sdGrossAndInvalids._range_note: ABSENT from the dossier section-2 configuration table. Conservative default = the SD retention floor (65) + the v3 31-day max range; probe-to-confirm in ROLLOUT_NOTES (spGrossAndInvalids is 365/365, so the SB/SD gross shapes MAY be wider).

report_type_compatibility._dsp_note: dsp* report types share the endpoint but require a DSP seat + Amazon-Ads-AccountId header; conversionPath/benchmarks are non-daily shapes. The connector WHITELISTS the 26 sponsored report types above: any other reportTypeId is a typed invalid_request BEFORE the API call.
report_type_compatibility._max_date_range_days_note: Review 26.5 F-4: this is the v3 DEFAULT window only. The authoritative bound is per-report-type report_types[*].max_range_days (spGrossAndInvalids 365, sbPurchasedProduct 731, prompt-ad-extension 90). connector.py refuses by the report type's own value; a type missing max_range_days falls back to this default.
